dearBen.title: Turkeys on the road
dearBen.question:
Dear Ben,

The wild turkeys in my neighborhood stand in the middle of the road every morning and won't budge. I'm late for work three days a week. What do I do?
dearBen.signoff: Stuck Behind the Flock in Eden
dearBen.answer:
Dear Stuck,

Take it from someone who has held up a few cars himself: turkeys don't hurry, and honking only gets you a turkey stare. Slow down, give them a minute, and never try to swing around them on a blind curve. Leave five minutes early and call it your morning nature show.

They'll move when they're ready. Turkeys run on Valley time.

P.S. I've been told I block traffic too. We have a lot in common.
